text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I can't believe I've been defeated
once
again...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I'm such a disgrace! A shame to the title
of
Empress!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list:
Hold onto that feeling and let it propel you
onward.

text_block_list.text: The only thing I feel right now is regret.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
However, I refuse to let myself dwell on
this
failure.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Forget what I just said. I lost my
composure and
spoke too soon.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it is as you say. No matter how
much I
complain, the crowd saw my poor
performance.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
My failure will remain forever, no matter
how
much I wish otherwise.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list:
We'll make them all forget by winning the next
one!

text_block_list.text:
A victory that supersedes this loss? A
win
outstanding enough to trivialize this
debacle?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm the one acting childish by
dragging
along this failure like some
kind of ball and chain.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
We're training as soon as we get back. I
won't let
this get me down!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I'll hold onto this regret and secure
victory!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
